title: Filament drying preparation: home only when the axes are not homed yet (screen and Fluidd)

edits:
[gcode_macro prepare_filament_dry]
gcode = 
    G28
    G1 Y260 F12000
[gcode_macro prepare_filament_dry]
gcode = 
    {% set homed = printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
    {% if 'x' not in homed or 'y' not in homed or 'z' not in homed %}
        G28
    {% endif %}
    G1 Y260 F12000
